summaries.zh: 人工智能正在重塑开发者职业阶梯。本文介绍了三种方法，帮助开发者在AI变革中脱颖而出，提升职业发展。GitHub博客发布。
summaries.en: AI is reshaping the developer career ladder, offering new opportunities for growth. To stand out, developers should focus on three key strategies to get noticed and advance their careers. The GitHub Blog highlights these approaches in its post, "AI is rewriting the developer career ladder. Here’s how to stand out." The article emphasizes adapting to AI-driven changes in software development to thrive in the evolving tech landscape.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases
items.content:
Describe the interface you need in plain English, then let the agent build a live surface you can both use and update—so you spend less time adapting to tools and more time getting work done.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Describe the interface you need in plain English, then let the agent build a live surface you can both use and update—so you spend less time adapting to tools and more time getting work done.
The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Kayla Cinnamon

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot应用入门：如何使用画布构建自定义工作流。通过用普通英语描述所需界面，代理将构建一个可共同使用和更新的实时界面，帮助用户减少适应工具的时间，更专注于完成工作。该文章首发于GitHub博客。
summaries.en: The article "GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases" explains how to create custom workflows using GitHub Copilot. Users describe their desired interface in plain English, and the agent generates a live, collaborative surface that can be updated together. This approach aims to reduce time spent adapting to tools and increase productivity. The article was originally published on The GitHub Blog.

items.title: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
items.content:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.

The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.
The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Alberto Gimeno

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot 实现了在应用中渲染百万行的大代码合并请求，并支持数百条行内评论。该应用通过重建差异界面，优化了大规模代码的加载和显示性能。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot app was updated to efficiently render very large pull requests, up to a million lines with hundreds of inline comments. The team rebuilt the diff surface to handle such massive files, improving performance and usability. This update enables smoother navigation and review of extensive code changes. The changes were announced on The GitHub Blog.
